scope: Explicit CPU, memory and ephemeral-storage declarations for regular and init containers. The source check sees the raw manifest. Admission sees defaulted resource values. The test runs without GPU hardware or device plugins.

checks.claim: API admits an unbounded regular container before policy
API admits an unbounded init container before policy
Kubernetes copies limits to requests before validating admission
Source checker catches omitted requests for both container classes
checks.observed:
containers/regular missing requests.cpu
containers/regular missing requests.memory
containers/regular missing requests.ephemeral-storage
initContainers/initializer missing requests.cpu
initContainers/initializer missing requests.memory
initContainers/initializer missing requests.ephemeral-storage

checks.claim: Admission rejects an unbounded regular container
